resolutions: Accepted0053 is named as the targeted BRIEF coordinator amendment and accepted0047/0059 replace the old worktree/sequencing literals; Shared later aligns BRIEF text.

Decision0066 explicitly amends only0057 agent retirement and0065/the scope lesson existing-First-scope limit for the later user model/team request; it preserves0064 question narrowing, original prepared hunk ownership, source/target binding and the eight-task graph. The complete overlay is First-owned and requires fresh normal task binding/proof before implementation.

The checkpoint preserves preliminary independent code inspection after contribution/verify but records no formal clean Forge review; platform results update the report, then a fresh complete brief and mandatory formal review bind readiness.

Integration encodes the exact six platform rows as a JSON array inside existing pass_fail_summary and validates exact fields/order/states/revision/logs and client proof before aggregate passed. Independent review checks actual evidence. C10 consumes the existing review-bound aggregate; no schema property, report or registry is added.

Lean writes raw helper output and three genuine validated projections as candidates in the existing review family and publishes the existing review-run pointer last. Explicit incomplete/exit2/missing chunk/lens/mixed binding refuses even when JSON exists; preserving a prior complete pointer never permits stale product proof.

Bind complete review-input digest/bytes, actual installed-helper identity, exact raw result, ordered complete pass_reports and three assessment outputs through the existing family. The installed helper does not emit per-chunk input hashes; no reconstructed private prompt manifest is promised. Complete lossless partitioning remains mandatory.

The spec retains separately bound existing gate records and makes shared reading only an assessment optimization; missing/unassessed/changed gate inputs refuse and Lean defines transient execution details in its JIT.

Shared reads neither share nor newly consume legacy structured-question provenance; until Shared ships complete identity, a structured round stays on its single-gate path and decision-free grills use canonical empty frontier.

After Shared ships, new questions bind runtime/session/event/tool-call/question/story/gate/task at capture with exact question/options/answer; each question in a multi-question call is independently eligible and single-use. Historical completed grills remain readable; no legacy identity is fabricated or reassigned.

The exact fields are design_review and nonblank design_review_rationale; the spec enumerates mechanical boundary, destructive, migration, public-contract, lifecycle and ownership triggers, keeps signoff mandatory and derives epics from capabilities.

Bundle keys are exactly format/story/events with forge-event-bundle/v1 and ID-sorted unchanged-payload members; equal ID/canonical payload deduplicates, same-ID unequal payload refuses, and distinct IDs remain distinct.

Only actual live per-file sources of an exactly validated shipped story can be cleaned. Existing bundles/history are immutable; unseen late IDs refuse untouched. Apply requires the preview inventory/shipped-proof/bundle digest; first publication cannot overwrite, and exact durable read-back precedes deletion. Legitimate legacy story-level runs do not acquire retroactive task-marker obligations.

Decision0066 deliberately defines same-name files/config as harness refresh targets and preserves distinct client-added agents through existing init/upgrade behavior; no TOML merge or provenance mechanism is promised.

Git registration and Forge ownership are distinguished; protected run.json published last is the owner record, and canonical worktree/Git-dir/common-dir location selects every owner/stage/delegation/lock/revocation record without duplicate fields.

Existing mechanisms are named: cancel writes the current tombstone before cleanup, terminal success/failure plus dead process/released lock revoke completion, and non-active stage incarnation revokes stage closure; no new marker work is added.

The approved First JIT whole-bundle rule is promoted: a legitimate committed marker selects exact plan/grill/approval/proof at seal with identity, ancestry, binding and unchanged-product checks; partial modern bundles refuse and sealed pre-merge CI remains eligible.

Shared uses one existing draft-PR-body checkpoint with exact Git/GitHub tuple, inspected diff/product/helper identity and actual raw helper output. Metadata-only E/M/N advancement uses ancestry plus unchanged classified product. Missing platform proof yields no formal review/marker; complete platform proof requires a fresh formal review before normal promotion.
The user-approved pins are Ruff0.16.6 and Pyright1.1.411, and coverage is exactly tracked Python below factory/scripts and factory/tests including fixtures, with the identical explicit local/CI set.
All candidates now say planning, decomposition, architecture, plan validation and grills use Sol/high; technical test verification remains with implementation and autoreview fixes at Sol/medium.

The user's bounded exception authorizes one /tmp Task tracker, one private authenticated origin and CI solely for story proof; acceptance requires clean install, declared lint/type/build/test checks and recorded create/list/complete persistence.

The amended story/graph explicitly crosswalk retained client failures, AC1-AC12, C1-C10 and three unchanged roadmap criteria to existing owners and concrete proof. Transitional old records must be replaced through normal gates before further implementation.
Accepted0064 explicitly narrows0057: only addressed or causally dependent work pauses; unaffected separately owned dependency-ready work may continue without treating silence as authority.

Lean adds optional explicit --context-file to the existing grill CLI/composer and reads one caller-selected regular UTF-8 snapshot as untrusted context without altering primary identity/authority or truncating it.

The installed CLI and live npm registry verify0.153.4; required CI pins @openai/codex@0.153.4. Main starts the separate normally governed Tasktracker after Quality ships; Integration requires its exact marker, reviewed PR, green CI and functional proof.

Native-Lifecycle emits required structured/redacted/correlated logs when existing transitions occur, bounds existing retries without adding automatic retry behavior, and tests cancellation/terminal error propagation. Integration preserves separate actual surface-specific logs.
summary: Resolved continuation of the genuine Sol/high spec read launch-3032e9f4f5f344b6b887f734f51cd722, informed by completed requirements read launch-c110b1635070497fbd5f1fd5e61f9580 and plan read launch-d04aad7951e1466d9cbd1f4da050506c. Findings are resolved from actual later user authority, accepted decisions and concrete corrections. No new human answer, repeated cold read, implementation proof or inherited old approval is claimed. Record only against the corrected saved draft; normal confirmation updates its status header.
